model: PATEK PHILIPPE Aquanaut 5168G (42.2 mm white gold, green embossed dial, green composite rubber strap)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot (at hand height). Variant of the Aquanaut template (config key 5168g-green, the SKU repeats in catalog 2 row 102 green and row 104 blue): same structure as config/watches/patek-aquanaut40-5167a001.json (case slab from the alpha silhouette, superellipse bezel ring with scanned window and chamfer, flat polygon dial with the native photo map, one fluted crown, one-piece rubber strap), re-measured on the 5168G green photo at 42.2 mm (scale 29.85 px/mm): case tips, hands, hub, crown, strap pieces and emissions are per variant. Step and kit lighting are the template's.

case.note: case slab = silhouette between the lug tips (tip_top / tip_bottom, 0.25 mm grid, sum a multiple of 0.25) with the crown rows replaced by a straight line, top and bottom sloping toward the strap; bezel = superellipse ring (min of the superellipse and the silhouette less silhouette_margin_mm, sampled by rays) at bezel_z, then a chamfer ring down to the dial window at chamfer_z

dial.note: flat polygon (the window less the chamfer) with the native photo map: embossed grid, applied numerals, indices, minute track, date window and the photographed hands stay in the map

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, last point at the traced length; measured on the 5168G green photo from rows rotated about the pivot (hour 302.6, minute 50.6, seconds 180.28 deg): frame half widths hour 28.0 / minute 24.7 px, lume inlay half 15.2 / 14.7 px, arrow shoulders at s 278 / 413 px, apexes 310 / 437 px, seconds shaft half 2.7 px to the tip at 448 px, counterweight tail to 153 px. lume = [s, half width] of the pale inlay. Hands and hub use hands_photo (reference photo projected from the front)

crown.note: crowns come from trace.crowns: a lathe about the axis (profile = [radius, mm along the axis] from the base point), flutes are texture

strap.note: strap.kind rubber, ONE full-width piece: edges = trace.strap_y_left_right_mm (silhouette outside the lug zone, measured lug inner walls inside it), from under the bezel (18.5 mm) to the rounded ends; the embossed grid pad of the photo is texture only

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
